search_text: published ZDI-25-262 ZDI-CAN-23199 (Pwn2Own) Tesla Model S Iris Modem QCMAP_ConnectionManager Improper Input Validation Sandbox Escape Vulnerability 2025-04-30 CVE-2024-13943 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-13943 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Tesla'] ['Model S'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escape the sandbox on affected affected Tesla Model S vehicles. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the QCMAP_ConnectionManager component. An attacker can abuse the service to assign LAN addresses to the WWAN. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to access network services that were only intended to be exposed to the internal LAN. Fixed in Firmware Version 2024.8 ['2024-02-28 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2025-04-30 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2025-04-30 - Advisory Updated'] Synacktiv (@Synacktiv) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-25-262/
title: (Pwn2Own) Tesla Model S Iris Modem QCMAP_ConnectionManager Improper Input Validation Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escape the sandbox on affected affected Tesla Model S vehicles. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the QCMAP_ConnectionManager component. An attacker can abuse the service to assign LAN addresses to the WWAN. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to access network services that were only intended to be exposed to the internal LAN.
